name: OptanonAlertBoxClosed
description: This cookie is set by websites using certain versions of the cookie law compliance solution from OneTrust.  It is set after visitors have seen a cookie information notice and in some cases only when they actively close the notice down.  It enables the website not to show the message more than once to a user.  The cookie has a one year lifespan and contains no personal information.

name: sessionID
description: This cookie is used to distinguish and create sessions by assigning a randomly generated number as identifier. It is included in each page request in a site and used to calculate sessions and campaign data for the sites analytics reports. By default, the cookie shall expire soon after the end of the session or at the latest 3,5 hours after being set.

name: __eoi
description: This cookie name __eoi is associated with Google which is used to detect spam and improve the website's security.

name: OptanonConsent
description: This cookie is set by the cookie compliance solution from OneTrust. It stores information about the categories of cookies the site uses and whether visitors have given or withdrawn consent for the use of each category. This enables site owners to prevent cookies in each category from being set in the users browser, when consent is not given. The cookie has a normal lifespan of one year, so that returning visitors to the site will have their preferences remembered. It contains no information that can identify the site visitor.

name: ak_bmsc
description: This cookie is associated with Akamai and is used exclusively to distinguish between human users and automated bot traffic, ensuring website security.

name: tik_vote_id_POLL_ID
description: The poll feature stores the selected answer and a random ID for each poll.

name: AKA_A2
description: This cookie is generally provided by Akamai and is used for the Advanced Acceleration feature, which enables DNS Prefetch and HTTP2 Push.

name: _ga_xxxxxxxxxx
description: This cookie is used to persist and identify the session state from your device.

name: _ga
description: This cookie is used to distinguish unique users by assigning a randomly generated number as a client identifier.

name: YSC
description: This cookie is set to track views of embedded videos and maintain statistics of what videos from YouTube the user has seen.

name: VISITOR_PRIVACY_METADATA
description: This cookie is set to store user consent preferences for cookies and advertisements.

name: VISITOR_INFO1_LIVE
description: This cookie is set to estimate the user's bandwidth on pages with integrated YouTube videos.

name: __cf_bm
description: This cookie is for Cloudflare to monitor traffic.

name: ak_bmsc
description: This domain is owned by Red Bull Company which provides information about their energy drinks, company history, events, athletes, and multimedia content.

name: sp_landing
description: This domain is owned by Spotify, a USA based music streaming service.  Spotify provides a number of tools to embed into websites, which enable the tracking of users and non-users across domains.

name: sp_t
description: This cookie/technology is set by Spotify. It is used for tracking user sessions and interactions on the platform. Spotify is a music streaming service. Privacy Policy: https://www.spotify.com/us/legal/cookies-policy/

name: _pk_id
description: Used to create pseudonymous statistics on website usage.

name: _fbp
description: We use the Meta Pixel Module to personalize ads that we show you on Facebook & Instagram and at the same time to measure and optimize the success of our marketing campaigns as well as to analyze our website traffic. For this purpose, Meta receives information about your usage behavior on our website. By sharing this information with Meta, we make sure the ads are as relevant to you as possible. Privacy Policy of Meta: https://www.facebook.com/privacy/policy/
